caption:
Can someone explain this? 😤

You can pay a card on time for years and still get a 'we noticed a change' letter the first time you're late.

One slip, and everything feels different.

Has a late payment ever caught you off guard?
first_comment: What surprised you most the first time you were late? 👇

card.headline: Why does one late fee feel bigger than years of on-time pay?
